page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred lines of text above and below a woodcut of a tree with figures and banners. Handwritten name in script over the top of the woodcut.
page.notes: The woodcut shows a large tree with spreading foliage, two figures at its base, and a scroll-like banner in the lower left and centre bearing partly legible words (the left one reads roughly "ET ... FRVCTV"-like letters, the central one "...FRVCTV..."), too worn to read reliably; not transcribed. The script name above the woodcut is handwriting, not print, and is left out. The date line is partly worn: "clo Ib c lxi" in the scan, read as MDCLXI. Several letters in the spaced capitals are blurred but legible.
